name: Default Professional Resume
description: Single-voice, employer-neutral resume template: one applicant voice, flagship credits first, honest capability gaps, ATS-safe print styles.

themeSync.note: External palette kits can be mapped into the default-resume.json token names, then mirrored into default-resume.css without changing Letter geometry.

verify._note: ⭐ SHARED VERIFICATION CONTRACT — every profile that `extends` this one inherits it (jenni · shade · martian · studio). Run these guards on EVERY generated doc (resume · cover letter · work-samples), for EVERY applicant, before it ships. Both are also documented repo-wide in AGENTS.md and docs/EXPORTS.md.

overflowGuard.rule: UNIVERSAL — applies to every applicant and every doc. Each page's content must FIT its box or the pinned footer collides with the last lines. Verify: `python -m pdf_tool.check_overflow <doc>.html --pdf-theme dark` (exits non-zero on overflow; also auto-warns on every html_to_pdf export). The structural guarantee is `overflow: hidden` on the print `.page` (clips instead of bleeding). If it warns, MOVE a section to the next page — never shrink the equal margin. Full model: docs/LAYOUT-SYSTEM.md.
overflowGuard.groundTruth: Verify a pagination/overlap fix against the ACTUAL exported PDF (rasterize with pypdfium2), not an HTML re-render — pdf_to_png re-renders the HTML and can disagree with page.pdf() pagination.

magentaGuard.rule: BRAND-SCOPED opt-in. Run `python -m pdf_tool.check_palette --no-magenta <doc>.html` for applicants whose brand bans magenta/pink (see perApplicant). Flags the magenta/pink hue band (~290-345°). The plain `check_palette` (no flag) always runs (no brown/mustard/lime).

perApplicant.shade: ⛔ NO magenta/pink — ALWAYS run --no-magenta. brand-synagen is violet+cyan; magenta is banned (owner directive 2026-07-20).
perApplicant.martian: ⛔ NO magenta/pink — ALWAYS run --no-magenta. brand-martian is orange/violet/cyan.
perApplicant.studio: ⛔ NO magenta/pink — run --no-magenta (studio speaks for Martian Games / can include Shade).
perApplicant.jenni: ✅ magenta/pink IS allowed — do NOT run --no-magenta. brand-jenninexus legitimately uses pink; the ban does not apply to her.

verify.otherGuards: check_palette (always) · check_vault --explain/--coverage (step 0/4a) · check_ats (light PDF). See AGENTS.md § Guards.

layout._note: ⭐ THE SHARED LAYOUT SYSTEM — every profile that `extends` this one inherits it (jenni, shade, martian, studio). SSOT: themes/default-resume.json#document + docs/LAYOUT-SYSTEM.md.

system.marginRule: EQUAL on all four edges (top = right = bottom = left). Default 0.65in via `@page { size: Letter; margin: 0.65in }` and the CSS knob `--resume-page-margin`. A doc may open the frame WIDER for a specific look (e.g. a formal cover letter at 0.75in) but must keep it equal — never asymmetric.
system.contentBox: 7.2in wide x 9.7in tall at the 0.65in default (8.5-2*0.65, 11-2*0.65).
system.headerFlowsFooterPins: Two page models, NOT interchangeable. RÉSUMÉ + WORK-SAMPLES (fixed page count): the header flows at the top inside the equal margin; the body region (.page-main) grows with flex:1; the footer/signature PINS to the bottom with margin-top:auto (.page-sig = résumé bottom-right, .page-foot = work-samples footer row), and print CSS sets an explicit .page height + overflow:hidden so the page count cannot silently grow. COVER LETTER (one page, flowing): the sign-off FLOWS after the body — .page gets height:auto with NO overflow:hidden, because @page{margin} already insets the printable area and a .page that also declares a height overflows the sheet, whereupon overflow:hidden CLIPS the sign-off while every DOM-based guard still passes (this shipped a cut letter on 2026-07-25). Enforced by check_generation's `letter-geometry` check. Contract: layouts/resume/one-page-letter.json. Reusable classes live in themes/default-resume.css.
system.printHeight: Give the print .page a fixed height of `calc(11in - 2 * margin)` so the flex footer pins to the page bottom.
system.contentFitRule: ⚠ EACH PAGE's content must FIT its box or the pinned footer collides with the last lines (the 2026-07-19 overlap bug). If a page overflows, MOVE a section to the next page or tighten that page's rhythm — never shrink the equal margin. VERIFY with `python -m pdf_tool.check_overflow <doc>.html --pdf-theme dark` (also runs automatically as a warning on every html_to_pdf export).

layout.screenPreview: Use visible Letter-sized wrappers (8.5in x 11in) with the equal margin as padding so page breaks + framing can be reviewed before export.
layout.footer: Footer/signature pins to the bottom via .page-sig / .letter-sign / .page-foot (margin-top:auto). The equal @page margin frames all four edges.

paths.note: html_to_pdf.py writes here by default when no explicit output PDF is passed; use --output-dir or a full output path to override.

exportModes.darkPdf: Run html_to_pdf.py with --pdf-theme dark; template must include html[data-pdf-theme="dark"] print overrides.
exportModes.bundlePdf: Run merge_pdfs.py final-application.pdf cover-letter.pdf resume.pdf --require-letter when a portal accepts one upload.
exportModes.png: Render generated PDFs to page PNG files with pdf_to_png.py.
